newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade turned fairly active in the panhandle area late Tuesday morning and carried into the early afternoon. Slaughter steers and heifers closed mostly $1.00 lower than last Thursday.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 30,000 slaughter steers and 18,400 heifers; 70,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,800 formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1050 lbs 62.00. Pen select and choice 1-3 1250 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00, small pen north plains 64.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1050 lbs 62.00. Confirmed: 48,400 Week Ago: 700 Year Ago: 2,600
Wk to date: 70,600 Week Ago: 30,000 Year Ago: 20,400
